gaps_closed.GOV-SCOPE-001: CLOSED — GovernedSourceSession is an explicit per-source execution owner created once per caller-bound source entry and reused for every admitted operation in that scope.
gaps_closed.GOV-DEC-003: CLOSED — decoder_invocations is a real account and budget, counted once at the decoder/session entry boundary, separate from reader_invocations.
gaps_closed.GOV-HDR-002: MECHANISM_SUPPLIED — header-prefix access occurs only when the plan explicitly admits a header_prefix_bytes size. The plan decision itself is left to the documentary lanes.

owns: one operation plan per admitted operation
owner_surface.reuse: created once per source entry; three plans run in one session produced decoder_invocations=3 and path_opens=1

generic_operation_plan.how_that_is_proven: court x3 AST-scans the module for SRCxx tokens in non-docstring string literals and in identifiers. The scan deliberately excludes docstrings, because this module's prose names those sources precisely to record that it does NOT encode their plans; a naive substring scan would flag that disclaimer as a violation.
generic_operation_plan.validation: incoherent plans are refused by SourceOperationPlan.__post_init__ BEFORE any access: SELECTED without variables, repeating names, selected_variables on a non-SELECTED mode, CHUNKED_FULL without chunk_rows, chunk_rows on a non-chunked mode, negative prefix, negative retries

key_correction.before: a non-null encoding alone forced a full row-data read (`elif encoding is not None: full_read(...)`)
key_correction.after: encoding is a reader configuration value; the row-data mode is decided solely by the plan
key_correction.measured: METADATA_ONLY with encoding='latin1' -> metadata_reads=1, selected_reads=0, full_reads=0, chunk_reads=0

header_prefix_discipline.rule: a prefix read happens only when the plan admits header_prefix_bytes
header_prefix_discipline.none_means: header_prefix_bytes=None admits no prefix access at all
header_prefix_discipline.measured_none: header_prefix_reads=0, header_prefix_bytes=0 across METADATA_ONLY, SELECTED and FULL
header_prefix_discipline.note: the plan VALUE for any particular source is not decided here

decoder_invocations.counted: once at the decoder/session entry boundary via admit_decoder_entry(), never once per reader call
decoder_invocations.distinct_from_reader_invocations: measured on a chunked decode: decoder_invocations=1 while reader_invocations = metadata_reads + chunk_reads = 5
decoder_invocations.legacy_path: decode_sav/decode_dta also call admit_decoder_entry() at their entry boundary, so the account is meaningful on both paths

decoder_integration.governed_path: decode_in_session(session, plan) uses the session-owned broker and never constructs a broker nor passes a path string to pyreadstat
decoder_integration.legacy_apis: decode_sav / decode_dta remain for source-free compatibility and now count their decoder entry; iter_batches still raises RawSourcePathEscape rather than falling back to a raw path
decoder_integration.receipt_live_and_complete: PhysicalSourceIncidence.source_access_receipt returns session.aggregate_receipt() when a session is attached, and the broker receipt otherwise; both are built live so later chunk reads are included
decoder_integration.close_source_access: closes the session when the incidence owns one, else the broker; idempotent
decoder_integration.context_manager: GovernedSourceSession and PhysicalSourceIncidence both support with/enter and deterministic cleanup on success and exception paths

byte_limiter_intact.one_byte_short: cap == required - 1 -> READER_BYTES_LIMIT_EXCEEDED having consumed exactly cap
byte_limiter_intact.never_beyond: reader_bytes <= cap at caps of required, required-1 and 16

self_corrections_disclosed.diagnosis: the court used a manual try/except, so the bound name is the exception itself rather than a pytest ExceptionInfo
self_corrections_disclosed.fix: corrected the court to exc.code; no production or session code was changed

self_corrections_disclosed.symptom: reported SRC02 hardcoded in the plan module
self_corrections_disclosed.diagnosis: a naive substring scan flagged the module's own docstring, which names those sources precisely to record that it does NOT encode their plans
self_corrections_disclosed.fix: replaced with an AST scan of non-docstring string literals and identifiers, so the check tests code rather than prose

explicitly_not_decided.SRC27_multiple_path_opens_normativity: NOT DECIDED in this lane, as commissioned. This lane supplies only the mechanism by which an explicitly planned prefix size either is or is not admitted.
explicitly_not_decided.source_specific_plans_or_budgets: none hardcoded; the plan value for any particular source remains for the documentary lanes
